ConnectionStrings._comment: Dev-only throwaway credentials for the local docker-compose Postgres container (see docker-compose.yml at repo root). NOT valid/used for any real deployment — never put production credentials in a committed file.

Jwt._comment: Dev-only throwaway HS256 signing key, matching the ConnectionStrings dev-credentials convention above. NOT valid/used for any real deployment — a real deployment must supply Jwt:Key via a secret store/environment variable, never a committed file.
